renders.prompt: Explain the argument of this song as if to a bright 10-year-old. Use ONLY the claims in the ESSENCE list below; every paragraph must correspond to at least one essence item (record indices). Do not add doctrines, comparisons, meta-commentary, or quoted terms. ESSENCE: [0] Long dwelling-with and total grace received, yet repeated forgetting; the only request is no more absence.

paragraphs.text: I have lived close to You for so long, and You have done everything for me — and still I keep forgetting You, over and over. So I am not asking for anything fancy. Just this: from here on, no more going away.

paragraphs.text: Long dwelling, total grace, repeated forgetting anyway. One request left, and it is negative: no more absence. That is the whole prayer.
